name: Warp Component

title.zh: Warp · 适合用代码化配置编排编码代理

description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 Warp 首页提供两条入口：下载面向 AI 辅助开发的终端，或申请 Warp Factories 早期访问。Factories 以 factory.yaml 定义仓库、密钥、MCP 服务器、云提供商与 Slack/Linear 集成，并列出 agents、automations、runners、skills、scorers、benchmarks 等配置项；页面还展示评测通过率、模型基准与自改进循环示意。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Warp (https://www.warp.dev/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
